summary: Iteration 9 (multi-reactions on main + Mingle + notifications, voice messages in chat, regression). BACKEND: 18/18 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_reactions_voice.py — (a) Reactions on main posts: POST /api/posts/{id}/react with 🔥 returns {liked:true,my_reaction:'🔥',likes_count:1,reactions:{'🔥':1}}; change to 🤑 keeps likes_count=1 and moves summary to {'🤑':1}; unknown emoji 'x' → 400; reaction:null → {liked:false,my_reaction:null,likes_count:0,reactions:{}}; GET /api/posts and GET /api/posts/{id} expose my_reaction + reactions; second user reacting bumps count to 2 with two summary keys; legacy POST /api/posts/{id}/like round-trips as 🩷 reaction. (b) Activity: after demo reacts 🔥 then changes to 🤑 on a fresh user's post, fresh user's /api/notifications has EXACTLY ONE 'like' entry from demo for that post with reaction=='🤑'; removing the reaction adds no new notification; self-reaction on own post → no notification. (c) Mingle: A (premium+Mingle profile) posts to /api/mingle/posts, B reacts via /api/posts/{id}/react → 200 with reactions {'🔥':1}; GET /api/mingle/posts shows my_reaction='🔥' for B; A's /api/notifications entry has mingle==true and actor.display_name == B's Mingle name and actor.username==''; non-member outsider POST react → 403. (d) Voice: POST /api/upload with tiny WAV → 201 type='audio' url starts /api/files/; POST /api/conversations/{c}/messages {audio_url, audio_duration:4.2} → 201 persists both fields; GET messages includes it; GET /api/conversations shows last_message=='🎤 Voice message'; audio_duration 61 → 422; audio_url outside /api/files/ → 400; empty body → 400; text + gif messages still 201. Mingle block: A blocks B via /api/mingle/block {user_id}; B → 403, A → 403 on POST voice; after DELETE /api/mingle/blocks/{B} A sends 201. Cleanup: fresh-user posts DELETE'd, fresh Mingle profiles soft-deleted, blocks removed. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x844 as demo): (i) Home feed — each post card shows compact post-react-<id> (heart outline when no reaction, not 8 emojis); tap opens reaction-picker with 8 reaction-option-<emoji> children; picking 🔥 renders post-my-reaction-<pid> with '🔥'; reopening picker shows reaction-remove; picking 🤑 swaps to '🤑'; reaction-remove returns to outline. (ii) Mingle Feed — Premium → premium-card-single_mingle-press → mingle-nav-feed loads mingle-feed-screen with post-mingle-tag-* on cards and no share/bookmark; picking 🔥 on a mingle post persists my_reaction='🔥' after re-navigating mingle-nav-feed (pull-to-refresh equivalent); removed cleanly. (iii) Chat thread — composer shows message-voice-button when input is empty and message-send-button when text is typed; tap voice-btn → voice-recorder bar with voice-cancel + voice-timer '0:00 / 1:00' + voice-record; env provided fake media so tapping voice-record started recording (timer moved to '0:01 / 1:00', status 'Recording… tap ■ to finish'); voice-cancel discards and returns to normal composer with message-voice-button back; existing prior voice-message bubble with play control + 0:04 duration renders correctly in the thread. (iv) Notifications screen — renders 'Activity' list with 'liked your post' entries and mingle activity (Said hi, is interested) without crashing.

issues: Copy for reaction notifications still says 'liked your post' regardless of the emoji chosen. The review request mentions 'reacted <emoji> to your post' phrasing — data-wise n.reaction is present, but the notification row does not surface it. Consider swapping to '<actor> reacted <emoji> to your post' when n.reaction is set.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter7-8: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning still fires when entering mingle screens. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/mingle-photos.tsx:41 and /app/frontend/app/mingle/index.tsx (inbox badge wrapper).

action_items: Minor (optional): Update notifications row copy in /app/frontend/app/notifications.tsx to show '<actor> reacted <n.reaction> to your post' when n.type=='like' and n.reaction is set, instead of the generic 'liked your post'.
Minor carry-over: Migrate remaining props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents in mingle-photos.tsx / mingle inbox badge wrapper to silence deprecation warning (present since iter7).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_posts.set_reaction() correctly: on change (existing like) issues db.notifications.update_many with the new reaction and does NOT re-notify — guarantees the 'exactly one like notification per (actor,post)' contract, verified end-to-end via TestReactionNotifications.

routes_posts.set_reaction() on reaction=None deletes the like row but intentionally does not touch existing notifications — matches the spec 'removing the reaction creates no new notification'. Verified.
routes_posts.enrich_posts() sets my_reaction only when a like row exists for viewer (mine.get(post_id) returns None otherwise) — GET /posts/{id} after removal correctly returns my_reaction=null.

routes_posts.react() validates against REACTIONS list before persisting → unknown emoji 400. reaction_summary() coalesces legacy nullable reactions to DEFAULT_REACTION (🩷) so legacy /like remains compatible.

routes_activity.list_notifications() flags mingle==true when post_id ∈ mingle posts and swaps actor summary via mingle_summaries → verified A's reaction notification carries Mingle display_name and username==''.

routes_chat.send_message() validates audio_url prefix '/api/files/' explicitly (400) and Pydantic bounds audio_duration to [0, 60] (422 at 61). Preview 'last_message' is '🎤 Voice message'. Symmetric block check via mingle_blocked_ids() returns 403 for both A→B and B→A while blocked.
routes_media.upload() maps audio/* content-types → kind='audio' and returns url with /api/files/ prefix — exact contract expected by the composer.

success_rate.frontend: ~100% — all listed testIDs present and interactive; reactions on main + Mingle feed verified with change/remove and persistence across nav; voice-recorder open/timer/record/cancel all worked in headless env with fake media; composer swap voice↔send verified; existing voice-message bubble renders with play + duration; notifications list renders without crash.

Created 1 conversation between demo and a fresh 'chatbud' user containing a voice message (audio_url), a text 'TEST_iter9 hello' and a GIF message — that conversation is now visible in demo's Chat list as 'Test chatbud 1b6c2c65' (backend has no delete-conversation endpoint; leave or main-agent may hard-delete via DB if desired). All test posts DELETE'd, mingle profiles for iter9 users soft-deleted via DELETE /api/mingle/me, all iter9 blocks removed via DELETE /api/mingle/blocks/{uid}. Demo's Mingle profile + premium membership left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 testIDs (all present and working): (a) Reactions — post-react-<pid> (compact control, heart outline when no reaction), post-my-reaction-<pid> (member's chosen emoji), post-reaction-summary-<pid> (top up-to-3 other emojis), reaction-picker + reaction-picker-backdrop + reaction-option-<emoji> for each of the 8 emojis 😂 🩷 🤑 🥳 🔥 🗣️ 🤗 🤬, reaction-remove (only when member already reacted). Same testIDs used on both main feed cards, Mingle feed cards, and post-detail. (b) Voice — message-voice-button (composer mic when input empty), message-send-button (composer send arrow when text present), voice-recorder bar with voice-cancel, voice-timer ('0:00 / 1:00'), voice-record; while recording voice-stop replaces voice-record; after stop → voice-preview + voice-preview-play + voice-send; sent bubbles are voice-message + voice-message-play + voice-message-duration. Blocked mic path: voice-open-settings inside voice-recorder. (c) Auth endpoint returns {access_token, token_type, user:{...}} — the JSON key is 'access_token' NOT 'token' (login helper fix). /me endpoint returns 405 — use user_id from the login response. /api/mingle/actions payload is {to_user_id, action} not {target_id, kind}. /api/mingle/block payload is {user_id, reason?}. Duplicate 'liked your post' rows in demo notifications are legitimate: they represent multiple react→remove→react cycles (each fresh 'insert' creates a new notification, as intended). Backend contract: reaction change updates the existing notification's `reaction` field; reaction remove is a no-op on notifications; only a *new* insert (no prior like row) creates a fresh notification.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only observation: the notifications UI copy for reaction events is still 'liked your post' without surfacing n.reaction; the backend already includes n.reaction so this is a pure UI-copy tweak, not a bug.
